# Grounded by live API capture captures/20260610T195745Z-api_order_rest_cancel_aapl.
# server_version=200, events.jsonl sha256 prefix: cab24496228ff1fb.
# Replays the resting-order cancel baseline (ORD-001) re-captured on
# 2026-06-10 against live paper Gateway with the 5-field cancel encoder: a
# far-from-market LMT BUY 100 AAPL rests at Submitted (open_order/order_status
# echoed twice), the API cancel produces order_status Cancelled plus the
# code-202 cancellation notice, and the driver's safety global cancel then
# draws a real code-161 "Cancel attempted when order is not in a cancellable
# state" for the already-cancelled order. In replay the 161 reaches the order
# route inside the terminal drain window, so the handle closes with the
# code-161 error. The April 2026 capture of the same scenario stays frozen in
# api_order_rest_cancel_aapl.txt; this fixture adds the safety re-cancel tail.
# Sanitized: account identifiers redacted to the DU9000001 redaction token,
# perm id -> 900337 (including inside the code-161 message text), order ref ->
# ibkrgo-sanitized-20260610T195745Z-001. Trimmed: farm-status 2104/2107/2158,
# the driver's startup safety global cancel, and the driver's delayed-quote
# anchor exchange (market-data-type toggles, the req 1/2 tick stream, and the
# code-10089 entitlement notice).
handshake {"server_version":200,"connection_time":"20260610 21:57:45 Central European Standard Time"}
server managed_accounts {"accounts":["DU9000001"]}
server next_valid_id {"order_id":337}

# far-from-market resting limit: delayed-quote anchor 292.25 / 20 = 14.61

client cancel_order {"field_count":"5","order_id":"337","manual_order_cancel_time":"","ext_operator":"","manual_order_indicator":""}
server order_status {"order_id":337,"status":"Cancelled","filled":"0","remaining":"100","avg_fill_price":"0","perm_id":"900337","parent_id":"0","last_fill_price":"0","client_id":"1","why_held":"","mkt_cap_price":"0"}

# safety re-cancel of the already-cancelled order: the live Gateway answers
# the global cancel with code 161 for order 337
client global_cancel {"field_count":"3","ext_operator":"","manual_order_indicator":""}
server api_error {"req_id":337,"code":161,"message":"Cancel attempted when order is not in a cancellable state.  Order permId =900337","advanced_order_reject_json":"","error_time_ms":"1781121475514"}

sleep 100ms
disconnect
